channel.title: News - National Crime Agency
channel.description: The National Crime Agency leads the UK's fight to cut serious and organised crime.

item.title: People smuggling network get combined jail terms of more than 84 years as final members sentenced
item.description: The final three members of a people smuggling network investigated and dismantled by the National Crime Agency have today (Wednesday 28 October) been sentenced.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Fisherman who attempted to smuggle 17 migrants into the UK on a yacht is convicted
item.description: An Albanian fisherman who skippered a yacht from France to the UK with 17 migrants on board has been convicted.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Five jailed over nearly half a tonne of cocaine in at-sea smuggling attempt
item.description: Five drug smugglers who were arrested as they moved nearly half a tonne of cocaine into Eastbourne Marina, have been jailed following a National Crime Agency investigation.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)

item.title: Four more men charged over ‘Mexican’ meth conspiracy plot
item.description: Four men will appear in court charged in relation to the alleged production of meth – after five Mexican men were charged as part of the same National Crime Agency investigation last month.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)

item.title: HGV people smuggling network dismantled by NCA as final members convicted
item.description: Five men who were part of a gang who circumvented border checks by hiding people in lorries to transport them to France have been found guilty of people smuggling, following an investigation by the National Crime Agency.
item.author: cms25@nca.gov.uk (cms-user25)

item.title: More couriers sentenced over £13.8 million cannabis importation attempt
item.description: Five members of a drugs smuggling gang who were part of a plot to import cannabis worth £13.8 million into the UK via Birmingham Airport have been sentenced.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)

item.title: 'Lord of Fraud’ Hugh Rodley admits child sexual abuse offences
item.description: A self-appointed lord convicted of two multi-million-pound frauds has admitted child sexual abuse offences, following a National Crime Agency investigation.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)

item.title: Child rapist sentenced after eight-year campaign of abuse
item.description: A South Manchester man who raped and sexually assaulted children as young as six over a period of eight years has been jailed for 23 years.
item.author: cms26@nca.gov.uk (cms-user26)

item.title: ‘Show me the money!’ Fraudsters sentenced after spending PPE supply money on luxury car and house renovations
item.description: Fraudsters who agreed millions of pounds in contracts to supply healthcare staff PPE during the Covid-19 pandemic but instead bought luxury cars and renovated their home have been sentenced.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Organised crime group sentenced for cocaine stash after PCTF investigation
item.description: Six men who were supplying cocaine in Northern Ireland have been sentenced after a National Crime Agency (NCA) and Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) investigation.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: 25 months in jail for woman who smuggled Thai cannabis
item.description: A 45-year-old woman has been jailed for 25 months after admitting smuggling 51.2kg of cannabis from Thailand on a flight to the United Kingdom, following a National Crime Agency investigation.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: NCA hosts international law enforcement and tech industry crackdown on fraud and scams
item.description: Almost 30 suspected scammers have been arrested and 3.7 million online profiles and accounts removed as part of a National Crime Agency-hosted crackdown against fraud perpetrated from across Africa.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Balkan Bridge 2 – NCA officers joined by international partners in major crackdown targeting cross-border smuggling of people and commodities
item.description: National Crime Agency officers have taken part in a major operation targeting transnational people smuggling gangs and organised crime in Bulgaria.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Operation Venetic: Drugs and firearms suppliers convicted
item.description: Two men who supplied pistols and ammunition to organised crime groups have been convicted and sentenced.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: New website launched for victims and survivors of child sexual abuse and exploitation
item.description: A new website providing victims and survivors of child sexual abuse and exploitation with information and support, as well as options in relation to requesting a review of a previously closed case, has been launched today.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Boats destined for people smugglers seized at East Midlands Airport
item.description: NCA and Border Force officers have seized 25 inflatable boats that were destined to be shipped to cross-Channel people smugglers.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)

item.title: Crime group members who smuggled large amounts of cash to the UAE are sentenced
item.description: Members of a crime group which smuggled almost £30 million of cash out of the UK to the United Arab Emirates hidden in suitcases have been sentenced.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Liverpool crime group guilty of Australia and New Zealand drug smuggling attempts
item.description: Members of a Liverpool organised crime group have been jailed for trying to smuggle drugs to Australia and New Zealand, following a National Crime Agency investigation.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: People smuggling boss hit with SCPO and told to hand over £290k proceeds of crime or face more time in jail
item.description: The convicted kingpin of an organised crime group that smuggled hundreds of people both into and out of the UK has been told to hand over £290,000 within three months, or face an extra two years in prison.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Gang ringleader arrested by the NCA convicted over Channel boat deaths
item.description: A man arrested by the National Crime Agency in connection with the deaths of at least 27 people who drowned attempting to cross the English Channel has been convicted in France.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)
